title: Inland Islanders Hobie Island Club
seo_title: Inland Islanders Hobie Island Club | Ottawa, Illinois
seo_description: Inland Islanders is a Quest Watersports-sponsored Hobie Island Club for Adventure Island and Tandem Island sailors on the Illinois River near Ottawa, IL.
body_html:
Welcome!

Inland Islanders is a group of Hobie Adventure Island and Hobie Tandem Island owners, and a local affiliate of the worldwide Hobie Island Club. Sponsored by Quest Watersports, Inland Islanders sail the waters of upper Illinois and the surrounding region. We are a diverse group, connected by our passion for sailing Hobie Islands. Join us on our next adventure!

Connect with the group

Visit the Inland Islanders Facebook group to see upcoming events, connect with other Island owners, and share your thoughts, ideas and pictures. Anyone is welcome to join.

How to join

Membership in Inland Islanders and the Hobie Island Club is open to any owner of a Hobie Adventure Island or Hobie Tandem Island sailboat.

  1. Go to the Hobie Island Club page.
  2. Click Inland Islanders on the "Find a Club" map (located in Ottawa, Illinois).
  3. Select "Join the Club" and complete the enrollment form. Have the hull ID/serial number from your Island handy.

Once you join, you will receive a FREE Island Club T-shirt!

Questions? Try an Island for free

For more information about Inland Islanders, contact Jeff at Quest Watersports. We are happy to answer any questions, and can even arrange a FREE tryout of a Hobie Island sailboat. Email Jeff or call 815.433.2200.

Looking for your own boat? See our Hobie sailboats and sailboat collection.
